definitions.gloss: lunch time; lunch hours; lunch service period
definitions.explanation: The time period during which lunch is served, typically when special lunch menus are available at restaurants.

examples.japanese: ランチタイムは{混|こ}んでいる。
ランチタイムは11{時|じ}から2{時|じ}までです。
ランチタイム{限定|げんてい}のセットメニューがお{得|とく}だ。
examples.english: The lunch-time-only set menu is a good deal.

notes:
ランチタイム refers to the lunch service period at restaurants.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ランチタイム{限定|げんてい} (lunch time only)
- ランチタイムのメニュー (lunch time menu)

USAGE NOTES:
- Usually 11:00-14:00 or 15:00
- Special pricing often available during this time
- Many restaurants close between lunch and dinner

RELATED TERMS:
- ランチ: lunch
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}: lunch (formal)
- ディナータイム: dinner time
